hero.headline: Painting & Home Improvement Services in Onalaska, WI
hero.subheadline: Interior and exterior painting, siding, drywall, and home repairs. Over 25 years of hands-on construction experience. Free estimates.

faqs.a: Yes. Estimates are free. Use the form on this page or call (608) 797-6803 and Benjamin will follow up about your project.

faqs.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
faqs.a: Interior and exterior painting, siding, drywall, roofing, remodeling, and general repairs and maintenance, for residential and commercial properties. If you're not sure your project fits, just ask.

faqs.q: Who will actually do the work?
faqs.a: Benjamin personally handles most projects. For larger jobs he brings in other experienced tradespeople.
Harr's Painting and Services is based in Onalaska, Wisconsin and serves the surrounding tri-state area. Call or send a request to confirm that your location is covered.

faqs.q: Are there discounts for new customers?
faqs.a: Ask about available discounts for first-time customers when you request your estimate.
